rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a Day-5 3BA blastocyst: expanded stage, B-grade loosely organized ICM, and cohesive TE. Minor overreach includes speculative comments about full/hatching status and subtle zona features not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, unexplained infertility, and especially prior IVF outcomes with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with favorable and unfavorable factors weighed appropriately. Slight limitation is that the implantation estimate may be somewhat broad/optimistic given repeated failures and untested ploidy.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET at age 33, luteal support adherence, no bed rest, and evaluation of uterine/tubal factors after repeated failure/ectopic. Minor deviations include somewhat nonspecific recurrent loss/failure workup framing and incomplete future-cycle planning due to truncation.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and follow-up, including SET, progesterone adherence, early beta-hCG/ultrasound, and uterine/tubal evaluation if unsuccessful. Useful but not maximally specific because the future workup section is truncated and lacks full prioritization.
